newsitem.title: USA: Healthdyne asks holders to defer decision.
newsitem.headline: Healthdyne asks holders to defer decision.

text.p: Healthdyne Technologies Inc said Tuesday it had asked its shareholders to postpone their decision on whether to accept or reject the $13-a-share takeover offer by Invacare Corp.

It said it will carefully study the unsolicited offer with the help of its financial adviser, Cowen & Co, and its lawyers. It said it will send its recommendation to shareholders no later than February 10.
"Shareholders should have time to receive the board's recommendation and act in an informed manner," said Healthdyne president and chief executive officer Craig Reynolds.
Reynolds noted that the Invacare all cash tender offer does not expire until February 24.
Healthdyne closed down 3/8 to 14-1/4 while Invacare closed up 3/4 to 28-1/4. Both are trade on the Nasdaq.
